label: FP
reason: The CodeQL alert reports a potential XSS vulnerability, but the data flow analysis shows that user-controllable input does not actually reach an HTML output sink. The vulnerable-looking code at lines 95-100 concatenates cookie values (getName() and getValue()) into a string, but these are not directly rendered to the browser. Instead, they are used in session management logic and cookie setting operations, which are not XSS sinks. The actual output to the browser (at line 96) uses only hardcoded strings and non-user-controlled data.

evidence.note: Code concatenates cookie name and value but these are not rendered to browser; instead used for session management and cookie creation.
The only output to browser uses hardcoded strings and non-user-controlled data.
